title: Printable probability tables
subject: Mathematics
source: Seeded from mathematics/y9 lesson 72 (Printable probability tables)
intro: Lesson 72: Mutually exclusive events. To understand how probabilities of mutually exclusive events add, and how all outcomes sum to 1

questions.q: Bag: P(red) = 0.2, P(blue) = 0.45, the rest green. P(green)?
Are 'even' and 'more than 4' on a dice mutually exclusive?
A spinner lands on A, B, C or D. P(A) = 0.15, P(B) = 0.3, P(C) = P(D). Find P(C), P(A or B), P(not D).
Explain why P(even or a 2) is not 1/2 + 1/6 on a dice.
questions.a: They are not mutually exclusive (2 is even): P(even or 2) = P(even) = 1/2

questions.q: The probability table has red x, blue 2x, green 0.1, yellow 3x. Find x.
Big question: when can we add probabilities?
questions.a: When the events are mutually exclusive.
